pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with moderately sharp pixel-level gradients at the edges. Geometry is predominantly convex with dark brown pigmentation that is slightly more saturated at the perimeters than the centers.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-cream pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-shaped) with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the visible neck area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. Individual hair bundles create a fine-toothed 1D geometric contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Visible nodular textural disruptions and raised bumps on the skin surface near the lower neck and shoulder transition, indicating localized structural anomalies.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the neck; one is fully visible in the upper-central region and another is partially visible on the lower-right edge.
